records.source: Oh! Aren't you the one who just moved in?#$b#I'm Maru. I've been looking forward to meeting you!$h#$e#You know, with a small town like this, a new face can really alter the community dynamic. It's exciting!
records.translation: Ah! Hindi ba ikaw ang bagong lipat dito?#$b#Ako si Maru. Inaasam kong makilala ka!$h#$e#Alam mo, sa isang maliit na bayang tulad nito, talagang mababago ng isang bagong mukha ang takbo ng komunidad. Kapana-panabik iyon!

records.source: Heh... sure! Suddenly, the dance sounds a lot more fun.$h
records.translation: Heh... sige! Biglang parang mas masaya ang sayawan.$h

records.source: Hey, what's this, a birthday gift? It's great! Thanks for remembering me!$h
records.translation: Hoy, ano ito, regalo sa kaarawan? Napakaganda nito! Salamat sa pag-alala sa akin!$h

records.source: Hey, what's this, a birthday gift? It's... uh, well, it's a gift! Thanks for remembering me, anyway.
records.translation: Hoy, ano ito, regalo sa kaarawan? Ito ay... uh, aba, regalo nga ito! Salamat pa rin sa pag-alala sa akin.

records.source: Mmm... How does it taste so good? This is really a great gift.
records.translation: Mmm... Bakit napakasarap nito? Talagang napakagandang regalo nito.

records.source: This will be perfect for powering my latest project! Thanks, @!$h
records.translation: Perpekto itong pagkukunan ng enerhiya para sa pinakabago kong proyekto! Salamat, @!$h

records.source: Ah, pure gold... It's not the strongest material, but it has some really useful properties!$h
records.translation: Ah, purong ginto... Hindi ito ang pinakamatibay na materyal, pero mayroon itong ilang talagang kapaki-pakinabang na katangian!$h

records.source: Oh, wow! That's a rare element. It's theorized that all the iridium in our world comes from meteorites...$h
records.translation: Ah, wow! Pambihirang elemento iyan. May teoryang nagmula sa mga meteorito ang lahat ng iridyum sa mundo natin...$h

records.source: Ooh, this is exciting! I'll deconstruct it and see if I can reverse-engineer the technology.$h
records.translation: Ooh, kapana-panabik ito! Kakalas-kalasin ko ito at pag-aaralan kung paano muling magagawa ang teknolohiya.$h

records.source: Ahh! Be careful with that! Are you touching it with your bare hands?$9#$b#... Sorry... hehe... With proper handling, this will be perfect for an exotic machine I'm building.
records.translation: Ahh! Mag-ingat ka riyan! Hinahawakan mo ba iyan nang walang guwantes?$9#$b#... Paumanhin... hehe... Kapag wasto ang paghawak, magiging perpekto ito para sa ginagawa kong kakaibang makina.

records.source: Ummm... Don't break the news to my Dad, okay? I'll handle it.
records.translation: Ummm... Huwag mo munang ibalita kay Tatay, ayos? Ako ang bahala.

records.source: Mmm... I'm having a hard time focusing on my work today.$l
records.translation: Mmm... Nahihirapan akong magtuon sa trabaho ko ngayon.$l

records.source: I want to go collect samples with my dad, but my Mom is insisting we stay here...
records.translation: Gusto kong sumama kay Tatay sa pagkolekta ng mga sampol, pero ipinipilit ni Nanay na manatili kami rito...

records.source: This is a rare opportunity to study a unique phenomenon... every moment counts!
records.translation: Pambihirang pagkakataon itong pag-aralan ang isang natatanging pangyayari... mahalaga ang bawat sandali!

records.source: I should've spent more time on that piece before showing you...$s
records.translation: Dapat ay mas matagal ko munang pinagbuti ang proyektong iyon bago ko ipinakita sa iyo...$s

records.source: How's your hand feeling?#$b#Let me see it... Hey, it looks all better!$h
records.translation: Kumusta ang kamay mo?#$b#Tingnan ko... Hoy, magaling na ito!$h

records.source: Hey, I guess we're brother and sister now!$h^Hey, I guess we're sisters now!$h#$e#I'm glad that Sebastian found a way out of the basement...#$e#I wish you two all the best!
records.translation: Hoy, mukhang magkapatid na tayo ngayon!$h^Hoy, mukhang magkapatid na tayo ngayon!$h#$e#Natutuwa akong nakahanap si Sebastian ng paraan upang makaalis sa silong...#$e#Hangad ko ang lahat ng pinakamabuti para sa inyong dalawa!

records.source: Hey, congratulations!$h#$b#I remember the first time Penny told me she had feelings for you...#$b#She was all shy about it, but I knew right away it was serious... she wouldn't say something like that if she didn't mean it!
records.translation: Hoy, binabati kita!$h#$b#Naaalala ko ang unang pagkakataong sinabi sa akin ni Penny na may nararamdaman siya para sa iyo...#$b#Hiyang-hiya siyang sabihin iyon, pero alam ko agad na seryoso ang nararamdaman niya... hindi niya sasabihin ang ganoong bagay kung hindi niya talaga ibig sabihin!

records.source: You always seemed far too healthy to be at the clinic so often... Now it's all starting to make sense...
records.translation: Lagi kang mukhang napakalusog para maging madalas sa klinika... Ngayon ay nagkakaroon na ng katuturan ang lahat...

records.source: Willy mentioned that you helped fix the boat. Thanks for doing that!
records.translation: Nabanggit ni Willy na tumulong kang ayusin ang bangka. Salamat sa pagtulong!

records.source: That was fun!
records.translation: Masaya iyon!

records.source: I've been noticing a few different starfish species. My favorite are the big purple ones, but they're all very interesting!
records.translation: Napansin ko ang ilang magkakaibang uri ng bituing-dagat. Paborito ko ang malalaki at kulay-lila, pero lubhang kawili-wili silang lahat!

records.source: *gasp*... It's a solar eclipse!$3#$b#Oh... never mind. It's just your body blocking the sun.
records.translation: *Napasinghap*... Eklipse ng araw!$3#$b#Ah... huwag na pala. Katawan mo lang ang tumatakip sa araw.

records.source: We're so far removed from civilization out here.#$b#Imagine the stars you could see at night.#$e#Who knows, maybe we'd even see a flying saucer or two!$h
records.translation: Napakalayo natin sa kabihasnan dito.#$b#Isipin mo ang mga bituing makikita mo sa gabi.#$e#Sino ang nakaaalam, baka makakita pa tayo ng isa o dalawang lumilipad na platito!$h

records.source: Mmmm... Why are tropical fruits so good?
records.translation: Mmmm... Bakit napakasarap ng mga tropikal na prutas?

records.source: I wonder if Willy would let me bring my telescope here sometime...#The sky is so clear here, I bet I could spot Pelican Town out in the horizon.#Maybe I'd even see you running around %farm Farm!
records.translation: Papayagan kaya ako ni Willy na dalhin dito ang teleskopyo ko balang araw...#Napakalinaw ng langit dito; sigurado akong matatanaw ko ang Bayan ng Pelican sa abot-tanaw.#Baka makita pa kitang nagpaparoo't parito sa %farm Farm!
records.englishResidueReason: The literal “Farm” is part of the protected %farm Farm runtime substitution form and must remain unchanged.

records.source: Of course... *whisper* Then can we go home and snuggle?$l
records.translation: Siyempre... *Bulong* Pagkatapos, maaari ba tayong umuwi at magyakapan?$l

records.source: I'm flattered! But... No.
records.translation: Nakatutuwa ang paanyaya mo! Pero... Hindi.

records.source: We have nothing to say to each other.$a
records.translation: Wala tayong dapat sabihin sa isa't isa.$a

records.source: Not good enough for you, huh?$a#$b#Fine...$s
records.translation: Hindi ako sapat para sa iyo, ha?$a#$b#Sige...$s

records.source: You've got some nerve, speaking to me!$a
records.translation: Ang kapal ng mukha mong kausapin ako!$a

records.source: You've lost some respect with me, @... but I'm willing to forgive you.$s
records.translation: Nabawasan ang paggalang ko sa iyo, @... pero handa akong patawarin ka.$s

records.source: Whenever I'm struggling with a technical problem, I always take a walk.#$e#It's surprising how much a change of scenery can help.
records.translation: Tuwing nahihirapan ako sa isang teknikal na problema, naglalakad ako.#$e#Nakagugulat kung gaano kalaki ang naitutulong ng pagbabago ng tanawin.

records.source: Have you met my mother? She's the town's carpenter.
records.translation: Nakilala mo na ba ang nanay ko? Siya ang karpintero ng bayan.

records.source: On Tuesdays and Thursdays I work at Harvey's clinic.#$b#He says he likes having me around in case his medical equipment goes haywire!$h#$e#Being a farmer must be pretty easy, huh?
records.translation: Tuwing Martes at Huwebes ay nagtatrabaho ako sa klinika ni Harvey.#$b#Sabi niya'y gusto niyang naroon ako sakaling sumablay ang kagamitang medikal niya!$h#$e#Siguradong napakadali ng pagiging magsasaka, ano?

records.source: I plan on spending a lot of time with my telescope this summer.
records.translation: Balak kong gumugol ng maraming oras sa teleskopyo ko ngayong tag-init.

records.source: Sometimes, when I'm looking into space with my telescope, I get struck with this eerie feeling... Like we aren't meant to see this.#$e#It's silly, I know...$h
records.translation: Minsan, kapag tumitingin ako sa kalawakan gamit ang teleskopyo, dinadapuan ako ng nakapanghihilakbot na pakiramdam... Para bang hindi natin dapat nakikita ito.#$e#Alam kong kalokohan iyon...$h

records.source: Do you know my Dad, Demetrius? He's a scientist. I have a lot of fun helping him out in the laboratory.
records.translation: Kilala mo ba ang tatay kong si Demetrius? Isa siyang siyentista. Masayang-masaya akong tumutulong sa kaniya sa laboratoryo.

records.source: It's really satisfying when you can repair something yourself, instead of just throwing it away.
records.translation: Talagang kasiya-siya kapag ikaw mismo ang nakapag-aayos ng isang bagay sa halip na itapon lang iyon.

records.source: Some people say 'magic isn't real'... but have they ever stopped and really thought about magnetism?
records.translation: Sinasabi ng ilang tao na “hindi totoo ang mahika”... pero huminto na ba sila at talagang pinag-isipan ang magnetismo?

records.source: If you think about the human body, it's hard to believe that somehow, it all just 'works'.
records.translation: Kung iisipin mo ang katawan ng tao, mahirap paniwalaang gumagana ang lahat nang kusa.

records.source: You know, I was thinking... even with all the technology in the world, nothing beats having a real human friend.
records.translation: Alam mo, naisip ko... kahit mayroon tayo ng lahat ng teknolohiya sa mundo, walang hihigit sa pagkakaroon ng isang tunay na kaibigang kapwa-tao.

records.source: Hey, sorry if I seem cranky... I'm a little sore from work yesterday.#$c .5# I had to carry ten boxes of medical files to the attic!#$e#I had to sort patient records for four hours straight!
records.translation: Hoy, paumanhin kung mukha akong mainitin ang ulo... Medyo masakit ang katawan ko dahil sa trabaho kahapon.#$c .5# Kinailangan kong dalhin sa atik ang sampung kahon ng mga talang medikal!#$e#Kinailangan kong pag-uri-uriin ang mga tala ng pasyente nang apat na oras nang tuloy-tuloy!

records.source: Hi!#$q 3/4 Sun_01_old#Do you have fun working on the farm?#$r 3 0 Sun_01_01#Yes.#$r 4 0 Sun_01_02#No.
records.translation: Kumusta!#$q 3/4 Sun_01_old#Nasisiyahan ka ba sa pagtatrabaho sa bukid?#$r 3 0 Sun_01_01#Oo.#$r 4 0 Sun_01_02#Hindi.

records.source: $p 3#Hey, you've made another week of progress on the farm! It seems like things are going well for you.$h|Another tiring week on the farm, huh? It must really be a lot of work...$s
records.translation: $p 3#Hoy, isa na namang linggo ang matagumpay mong natapos sa bukid! Mukhang maayos ang kalagayan mo.$h|Isa na namang nakapapagod na linggo sa bukid, ano? Talagang napakaraming gawain siguro...$s

records.source: Well that's good, isn't it?$h
records.translation: Mabuti iyon, hindi ba?$h

records.source: Yikes! I'm sorry. Have you ever thought of doing something different...?$s
records.translation: Naku! Paumanhin. Naisip mo na bang gumawa ng ibang bagay...?$s

records.source: Stop by our house when you need to upgrade your buildings.#$e#It's always nice to have visitors.
records.translation: Dumaan ka sa bahay namin kapag kailangan mong pahusayin ang mga gusali mo.#$e#Laging masarap magkaroon ng mga bisita.

records.source: My mother is a carpenter and my dad is a scientist. I guess it makes sense that I'm into building gadgets.
records.translation: Karpintero ang nanay ko at siyentista ang tatay ko. Siguro ay makatuwiran kung bakit mahilig akong gumawa ng mga aparato.

records.source: My Dad is very logical, and my Mom is very intuitive. That difference leads to conflict, sometimes...$s
records.translation: Napakamakatwiran ni Tatay, at napakalakas naman ng kutob ni Nanay. Nagdudulot kung minsan ng alitan ang pagkakaibang iyon...$s

records.source: Sometimes my head gets so cluttered with nonsense I can hardly think. Does that ever happen to you?#$e#Getting some fresh air usually helps.
records.translation: Minsan ay napupuno ng walang-kabuluhang bagay ang isip ko kaya halos hindi ako makapag-isip. Nangyayari rin ba iyon sa iyo?#$e#Karaniwang nakatutulong ang paglanghap ng sariwang hangin.

records.source: I'm glad to have a job at the clinic... I feel like I'm helping people in town.#$e#Dr. Harvey? He's nice, but not really my type...
records.translation: Natutuwa akong may trabaho ako sa klinika... Pakiramdam ko'y nakatutulong ako sa mga tao sa bayan.#$e#Dr. Harvey? Mabait siya, pero hindi ko talaga siya tipo...

records.source: Oh, @! Is there anything you want to talk to me about?$l
records.translation: Ah, @! May gusto ka bang ipakipag-usap sa akin?$l

records.source: Of course he'll know the difference! This sample is completely ruined!%fork$s
records.translation: Siyempre ay mapapansin niya ang pagkakaiba! Lubos nang nasira ang sampol na ito!%fork$s

records.source: Okay. I'll blame it on you, then.$u
records.translation: Sige. Ikaw na lang ang sisisihin ko.$u

records.source: You're right. I should just tell him the truth.%fork$u
records.translation: Tama ka. Dapat ko na lang sabihin sa kaniya ang totoo.%fork$u
